description: This file contains classes and functions for capturing and filtering logging events within the behave testing framework, including a BufferingHandler subclass, a RecordFilter class, and a decorator for capturing logs during test execution.

classes.name: RecordFilter
classes.description: Implements filtering of logging records based on include/exclude lists.

classes.name: LoggingCapture
classes.description: A BufferingHandler subclass that captures log records in memory, with methods to start/stop capturing and search within the buffer.

methods.name: capture
methods.description: Decorator to capture logs during behave test steps, with options for log level and display on success.
